- inc-002: Hard freeze (no dump), SleepInProgress !=0

- inc-004 on 2026-07-21: DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION (0x133), nvlddmkm.sys
- inc-005: Hard freeze (no dump), SleepInProgress !=0
- inc-006 on 2026-10-23 (last incident date per summary): VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE (0x116), nvlddmkm.sys
Repetition threshold: 4 incidents within 90 days (2026-04-22 .. 2026-07-21).

Error Codes and Module:
- 3x DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION (0x133) - GPU ISR timeout
- 1x VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE (0x116) - GPU TDR recovery failure
- 2x Hard freeze without dump (BugcheckCode 0x0)
- Responsible module in all dumps: nvlddmkm.sys (NVIDIA graphics)
- 3 dumps (inc-001 on 2026-04-22, inc-003 on 2026-07-17, inc-004 on 2026-07-21) share FAILURE_BUCKET_ID 0x133_ISR_nvlddmkm!unknown_function and FAILURE_ID_HASH {f97493a5-ea2b-23ca-a808-8602773c2a86} - same failure category.

- No disk errors, no WHEA CPU/memory errors, no CPU thermal throttling, and no repeated application failures were logged as alternative root cause.

Hypotheses (not confirmed as fact):
- Correlation with sleep/wake: 3/6 incidents had SleepInProgress !=0 (inc-002, inc-003, inc-005). This is hypothesis, not proven.
